title: Sanna has a new career

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't know you came out this far. Hive Mall huh! It's not as fancy as it used to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I didn't know you came out this far. Hive Mall huh! It's not as fancy as it used to be.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I meant to come talk to you. About the job...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I meant to come talk to you. About the job...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: That's what I wanted to tell you. I actually... found something else. Another job - a good one. I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I wanted to tell you. I actually... found something else. Another job - a good one. I think.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Remember I told you about my... break up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remember I told you about my... break up?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Nice to know I made an impression. What's the point of misery if it's not even memorable?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice to know I made an impression. What's the point of misery if it's not even memorable?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Look, I know no one wants to know all the boring details of my break up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I know no one wants to know all the boring details of my break up.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Look, I won't bother you with the details of my broken fucking heart, but I needed to find work, FAST, and preferably something where I wouldn't have to serve my ex and her... new boyfriend noodles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I won't bother you with the details of my broken fucking heart, but I needed to find work, FAST, and preferably something where I wouldn't have to serve my ex and her... new boyfriend noodles.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Imagine that. Me asking if Marina wants, I dunno, an espresso. Meanwhile I'm...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Imagine that. Me asking if Marina wants, I dunno, an espresso. Meanwhile I'm...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Exactly. So I got a new gig. Something that gets me out and about a bit more, and pays... ok. Considering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. So I got a new gig. Something that gets me out and about a bit more, and pays... ok. Considering.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Sarcasm. This is the worst job in the world. I go to dangerous locations and write reports on how to minimize damage to commerce.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sarcasm. This is the worst job in the world. I go to dangerous locations and write reports on how to minimize damage to commerce.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I'm contractually obligated to tell you it's not. And to recommend you go about your business as usual. In fact, that's the main part of this job. Telling people everything is ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm contractually obligated to tell you it's not. And to recommend you go about your business as usual. In fact, that's the main part of this job. Telling people everything is ok.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Yup. Officially... absolutely everything is ok here. But if you don't have a good reason to be here, I recommend you conclude any important business transactions... and if you feel the ground rumble under your feet, run.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup. Officially... absolutely everything is ok here. But if you don't have a good reason to be here, I recommend you conclude any important business transactions... and if you feel the ground rumble under your feet, run.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Alright, I'm gonna get back to work. My next posting is the Oil Rig - which is not in any kind of danger of capsizing. It's also where me and Marina had our first kiss. Fuck my life I guess?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I'm gonna get back to work. My next posting is the Oil Rig - which is not in any kind of danger of capsizing. It's also where me and Marina had our first kiss. Fuck my life I guess?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Sure. And hey... thanks for the chat. It... wasn't nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. And hey... thanks for the chat. It... wasn't nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hi Sanna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi Sanna.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You still want to work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still want to work for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You still want to work for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You still want to work for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's hard to keep track of all the sad stories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hard to keep track of all the sad stories.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's hard to keep track of all the sad stories.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's hard to keep track of all the sad stories.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Try me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Try me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Correct.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Crying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crying?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mad?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Feeling depresso?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feeling depresso?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you spelunking again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you spelunking again?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I'm never exploring a cave again - not unless I can afford a new spine and some upgraded kneecaps. So I'm doing the next best thing. I'm going to all the most dangerous parts of the city as a corporate risk assessor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm never exploring a cave again - not unless I can afford a new spine and some upgraded kneecaps. So I'm doing the next best thing. I'm going to all the most dangerous parts of the city as a corporate risk assessor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's the next best thing to spelunking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the next best thing to spelunking?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's the next best thing to spelunking?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's the next best thing to spelunking?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, is it dangerous here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, is it dangerous here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Phew! I'm glad everything is ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Phew! I'm glad everything is ok.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Phew! I'm glad everything is ok.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Phew! I'm glad everything is ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is everything ok though?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is everything ok though?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll bear that in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll bear that in mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Sanna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Sanna.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I cannot give you a lot of hope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I cannot give you a lot of hope.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I cannot give you a lot of hope.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I cannot give you a lot of hope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And that's why you're here. I see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And that's why you're here. I see.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And that's why you're here. I see.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And that's why you're here. I see.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hope to see you again, Sanna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hope to see you again, Sanna.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hope to see you again, Sanna.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hope to see you again, Sanna.
